journey_type_reason: 任务聚焦 Brain 内部 merge authority、审批路由与 merge gate，验收以本地 API 和回归测试完成。

tasks.title: 收归 Kernel 唯一 Merge Authority 并移除标题型合并旁路
tasks.scope: 把 Kernel-owned PR 的 ownership 绑定到 repo、pr_number、run_id、head_sha，补齐 authenticated approve/reject、human_review 落账、stale SHA 失效、merge head 原子锁定，以及 CI/legacy merge caller fail-closed。
dod: [BEHAVIOR] approve route 缺少 repo 或 pr_number 时拒绝且不写 human_review verdict
[BEHAVIOR] approve route 记录含 approved_by pr_head_sha source timestamp repo pr_number run_id 的 human_review detail
[BEHAVIOR] mergeGate 对 stale human approval fail-closed 并要求重跑证据链
[BEHAVIOR] merge_pr 调用 gh 时必须传 --match-head-commit 当前 head_sha
[BEHAVIOR] 标题 feat(harness) 或 cp- branch 本身不能决定 Harness merge authority
[ARTIFACT] 合同测试文件覆盖 approve/reject、ownership resolver、merge lock、旧 CI 脚本
